title: Coin-Ops general infrastructure defaults
description: Global defaults used by Terraform modules when a more specific cloud or instance setting is not provided.

project_name.description: Short project name used in cloud resource names.

region_profile.description: Logical region profile resolved through cloud_mappings.json.

image_profile.description: Logical image profile resolved through cloud_mappings.json.

instance_size.description: Logical instance size resolved through cloud_mappings.json.

disk_size.description: Default VM boot disk size in GiB.

has_public_ip.description: Default public IP behavior for instances that do not override it.

username.description: Linux user created and used for SSH/Ansible access.

user_init_script.description: Path to the default cloud-init/user-data template.

ssh_port.description: SSH port exposed by managed hosts.
